FULL TEXT:
MASTERS’ DEGREE PROGRAMME – 2025-26
INSTRUCTIONS
“The applicants shall read this Information Bulletin before filling up
the application form and exercise as many as options possible in
order to become eligible for all seats, because in subsequent rounds
additional options cannot be executed”. The seats are likely to
change in final seat matrix. University reserves rights to withdraw
or add seats as per the prevailing situation. Candidates are advised
to visit kvafsu.edu.in web site daily at least twice until counseling is
over. No postal correspondence will be sent. On 08.02.2026, ICAR
un-filled seats reverted back to university will be made available for
option entry, as per Karnataka Government Roster Policy.
Single * in seat availability indicates ICAR non-accredited
seats. The candidates before executing choices of ICAR
non-accredited seats should be aware that they are not eligible to
pursue their education in States other than Karnataka. However,
they are eligible to pursue their higher education within
Karnataka only.

Reservation and Sequence of Seat Allotment for
